snippet.title: Delhi Police Checks Buses at Chilla Border Ahead of October 10 Jantar Mantar Protest
snippet.description:
Ahead of today’s protest at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi, Delhi Police personnel were seen stopping a private bus at the Chilla border between Uttar Pradesh and Delhi. Police checked the passenger list on the conductor’s phone and asked commuters about their destinations. Most passengers said they were heading to Kashmere Gate.

A police personnel said commercial four-wheelers were also being checked, as people could book Ola and Uber rides to reach Jantar Mantar.

snippet.description:
